name: web-search.setpoint-read
purpose: Read every row of web-search's improve setpoint in one submission and report each as in band, out of band, or unavailable, without estimating.

decayed_below.description: Effective confidence under which a never-surfaced finding counts as decayed.

count_window.description: TimeWindowToken enum name for findings count.

assumptions: web-search is running for the ledger rows; search-hub is running for the routing and lifecycle rows
the caller treats an unavailable row as unknown, never as zero
cache-hit-rate and budget-exhaustion stay unavailable until web-search declares measures for them
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no row set is materialized; every reading is count, head, or filter
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
a row whose sensor has no governed binding is reported unavailable with the reason, not computed by hand

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason}; one per setpoint row in the improve skill's table order: surfaced-rate, used-rate, never-surfaced-share, live-vs-local-ratio, cache-hit-rate, budget-exhaustion, provider-lifecycle, capture-volume
signals.readable: count of rows read from a governed binding
signals.unavailable: count of rows not readable in-program

outputs.evidence: sensor command names, one per row
